title: Sông không tên
about: A new piece in the dem-diu style (round 12): 80 bpm, F# Dorian (i-IV, F#m-B: the raised sixth D# in the tune, folk-like rather than sad), a middle that darkens to D and A (D natural against the D# before), and the last part carried a whole step up into G# Dorian, as a river turns, ending there.
